    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.finrank_le_homFinrank_restrictObj (k F R : Type u) [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [Module.Finite k F] {S : FGModuleCat R} {N : FGModuleCat (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)} (f : S ⟶ restrictObj k F R N) (hf : f ≠ 0) :

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.endolength_le_of_stable_hom_to_restrictObj (k F R : Type u) [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [Module.Finite k F] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)] (P : TwoTerm R) {S : FGModuleCat R} {N : FGModuleCat (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)} (hN : (TwoTerm.eulerWeight F (extendTwoTerm k F R P)).IsSemistable N) (hS : (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k P).IsStable S) (f : S ⟶ restrictObj k F R N) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    endolength k S ≤ Module.finrank F ↑N.obj

    An embedded stable ground module has endolength at most the extension dimension of its semistable source of restriction.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.exists_bounded_stable_subobject_restrictObj (k F R : Type u) [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [Module.Finite k F] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)] (P : TwoTerm R) (N : FGModuleCat (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)) (hN : (TwoTerm.eulerWeight F (extendTwoTerm k F R P)).IsStable N) :
    ∃ (S : FGModuleCat R) (i : S ⟶ restrictObj k F R N), CategoryTheory.Mono i ∧ (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k P).IsStable S ∧ Module.finrank k ↑S.obj ≤ Module.finrank k F * Module.finrank F ↑N.obj ∧ endolength k S ≤ Module.finrank F ↑N.obj

    Stable extension modules produce ground stable witnesses with both dimension and endolength bounds.
